Class RollerConfig

java.lang.Object
frc.spectrumLib.sim.RollerConfig
public class RollerConfig extends Object
Configuration data for a roller mechanism simulation. Stores physical properties, display colors, canvas position, and optional mount attachment used by RollerSim.

    • setReversedLinkage

      public RollerConfig setReversedLinkage(boolean reversedLinkage)
      Mirrors the simulated motor so the sim's travel matches the motor's positive direction. See SimMotor.simState(com.ctre.phoenix6.hardware.TalonFX, boolean).
      Parameters:
      reversedLinkage - true when the sim travels opposite the motor
      Returns:
      this config, for chaining
